findings.suggested_fix: Use idiomatic Greek forms for these book references, e.g. «Η Α΄ προς Κορινθίους 11:31-32», «Ο Ησαΐας 5:20» and «Οι Παροιμίες 2:6-9», applying the same convention consistently to the other book references.
